title: Transport Plus
summary: Multi-tenant fleet platform for coaches in Malta, airport, and shuttle drivers. Production Driver client with trip lifecycle, background GPS, Firebase push, roster, and cash reconciliation.

content.heading: Project Overview
paragraphs: Transport Plus is a multi-tenant fleet platform used by coach, airport-transfer, and shuttle operators in Malta. I built the production Driver client in Flutter: trip lifecycle, background GPS, Firebase push, roster and vehicle assignment, and cash reconciliation.

The app is structured with BLoC and Clean Architecture so trip state, location, and settlement flows stay testable and independent of the UI. REST APIs, SQLite, and secure storage support offline-tolerant driver work; Firebase handles push and operational messaging.

specs.Tech Stack: Flutter, BLoC, Clean Architecture, GetIt, REST, SQLite, Firebase

process.title: Architecture
process.description: BLoC + Clean Architecture with GetIt, so trip, roster, and reconciliation rules sit behind the UI.

process.title: Trip lifecycle
process.description: Driver flows for taxi, airport-transfer, and shuttle jobs: assignment, in-progress state, and completion.

process.title: Location and messaging
process.description: Background GPS for fleet tracking and Firebase push for trip and roster updates.

process.title: Operations
process.description: Roster and vehicle assignment, cash reconciliation, REST sync, SQLite, and secure storage.

toolsDescription: Flutter Driver client with BLoC, Clean Architecture, GetIt, REST, SQLite, secure storage, and Firebase.

title: Localway Traveller
summary: Flutter traveller app for Localway, a Sicily experiences marketplace. Bookings, maps, Stripe-backed checkout, host–guest chat, reviews, and EN/IT localisation — one part of a three-app suite.

content.heading: Project Overview
paragraphs: Localway is an Italian tourism marketplace in Sicily where travellers book experiences from Local Advisors. I built the Flutter traveller app as part of a three-app suite alongside an Angular public storefront and an Angular host/admin portal.

The traveller client covers discovery, bookings, maps, host–guest chat, reviews, and English/Italian localisation, talking to the same REST and Socket.IO backend as the web products, with Stripe for checkout.

specs.Tech Stack: Flutter, BLoC, REST, Socket.IO, Google Maps, Stripe

process.title: Traveller product
process.description: Flutter app for browsing and booking Sicily experiences, aligned with the Angular storefront.

process.title: Maps and localisation
process.description: Google Maps for experience location, with EN/IT copy resolved in the client.

process.title: Realtime and payments
process.description: Socket.IO for host–guest chat and Stripe-hosted checkout against the shared backend.

process.title: Reviews and bookings
process.description: Booking lifecycle and reviews so the traveller app matches the rest of the Localway suite.

toolsDescription: Flutter traveller client using BLoC, REST, Socket.IO, Google Maps, and Stripe, shared with the Angular Localway apps.

title: Localway Storefront & Admin
summary: Angular public storefront and host/admin CMS for Localway in Sicily. Bookings calendar, Stripe Checkout/Connect, host–guest chat, reviews, and EN/IT localisation.

content.heading: Project Overview
paragraphs: Alongside the Flutter traveller app, I built Localway’s Angular public storefront and Angular host/admin portal. Hosts manage experiences, a bookings calendar, and content; travellers book on the web with the same EN/IT localisation as the mobile app.
The admin side is a CMS with role-based dashboards. Checkout uses Stripe Checkout and Connect payouts. Host–guest chat and reviews sit on REST plus Socket.IO, with Google Maps on experience location.

specs.Tech Stack: Angular, TypeScript, REST, Socket.IO, Stripe, Google Maps

process.description: Public Angular app for discovering and booking Sicily experiences, with EN/IT localisation.

process.title: Host and admin CMS

process.title: Payments
process.description: Stripe-hosted checkout for travellers and Connect payouts for hosts.

process.title: Realtime
process.description: Socket.IO host–guest chat and REST APIs shared with the Flutter traveller app.

toolsDescription: Angular storefront and admin CMS with TypeScript, REST, Socket.IO, Stripe Checkout/Connect, and Google Maps.

title: FreeHour
summary: Angular student web app for Malta institutions: swipeable timetables, Who’s Free matching, lecture/task/exam events and countdowns, Google Calendar sync, friend/discover flows, and student offers and jobs.

content.heading: Project Overview
paragraphs: FreeHour is a student productivity and social platform for Malta institutions. I built the Angular frontend: swipeable timetables, Who’s Free matching against friends’ calendars, lecture/task/exam events and countdowns, Google Calendar sync, friend and discover flows, and student offers and jobs.
The client is Angular with TypeScript and RxJS, talking to REST APIs and Firebase so timetable and social state stay in sync across the campus product.

process.title: Who’s Free

process.title: Calendar sync
process.description: Google Calendar sync plus friend and discover flows.

process.title: Campus extras
process.description: Student offers and jobs alongside the core academic and social product.

toolsDescription: Angular frontend with TypeScript, RxJS, REST, and Firebase, including Google Calendar sync.

title: Azora
summary: Flutter client for a Malta accounting SaaS used by company contacts of an accounting firm. Multi-tenant accounting client with OTP/MFA, offline document capture, realtime AI invoice updates, VAT returns, and in-app payments.

content.heading: Project Overview
paragraphs: Azora is a Flutter client for a Malta accounting SaaS, used by company contacts of an accounting firm. I built the multi-tenant mobile app: OTP/MFA login, multi-company switching, offline document capture with Hive sync, Socket.IO updates for AI-processed invoices, VAT and tax-return workflows, and in-app WebView payments.
State is BLoC; networking is Dio; local capture syncs through Hive; realtime invoice status arrives over Socket.IO; payments run in an in-app WebView with secure storage for session material.

specs.Tech Stack: Flutter, BLoC, Dio, Hive, Socket.IO, WebView, secure storage

process.description: OTP/MFA login and multi-company switching for accounting-firm contacts.

process.title: Offline capture
process.description: Document capture on device with Hive sync when connectivity returns.

process.title: Realtime invoices
process.description: Socket.IO updates as invoices are processed by the AI pipeline.

process.title: Tax and payments
process.description: VAT and tax-return workflows, with in-app WebView payments and secure storage.
